item.title: Skillori 0.2.27
item.description: Fixes from a review of the last two versions. Updates found before you answered the macOS notification question are no longer lost: once you allow notifications, the next check tells you about everything that is waiting. A new installation always waits for first start to close before it asks anything. First start, Settings and the privacy text now also say that plugins are checked and that Codex is asked which plugins it has.
